_comment: StarTruckMP egg NO-SSL v1.8.0 - package unified. HTTP uniquement, aucun certificat. Binaire autonome: aucun runtime a installer.
name: StarTruckMP No-SSL
author: admin@example.com
description: Serveur multijoueur Star Trucker (StarTruckMP Enhanced 1.8.0 no-SSL, protocole 3). HTTP uniquement, port unique 7777 TCP+UDP.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# StarTruckMP 1.8.0 no-SSL - install Pterodactyl
# Binaire AUTONOME (self-contained) : aucun runtime .NET a installer.
# Contenu de linux-nossl/ via SFTP, ou telechargement auto depuis GitHub (DOWNLOAD_URL).
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip tar ca-certificates >/dev/null
cd /mnt/server
if [ -n "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ]; then
  echo "Telechargement $DOWNLOAD_URL ..."
  curl -fsSL "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o /tmp/srv
  (unzip -o /tmp/srv -d /mnt/server || tar xzf /tmp/srv -C /mnt/server)
  rm -f /tmp/srv
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/StarTruckMP.Server 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data
echo 'Installation terminee (no-SSL, HTTP)'
